name: Brown Butter Banana Bread
description: Browning the butter adds a toasty, nutty note to a classic loaf. The blacker the bananas, the better.
recipeIngredient: 100 g unsalted butter, plus extra for the tin

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare
itemListElement: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Butter and line a 900 g loaf tin.
Melt the butter in a small pan and keep cooking until it smells nutty and flecks of brown appear. Cool slightly.

itemListElement.text: Mash the bananas in a large bowl, then beat in the brown butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, bicarbonate of soda, cinnamon and walnuts until just combined.
Scrape into the tin and bake for 55–60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out.
